findings.claim: Expedia Q3 2026 (reported 2026-11-04): total gross bookings +11%, B2B +19%, B2C +7%, room nights +7%; FY2026 gross bookings guidance raised to $131.4-131.9B; Q4 guided +3.3-5.2% with management citing election-related softness, geopolitical disruption and tougher B2B comps.
findings.source: Expedia Group Form 8-K Q3 2026 earnings release / search summary

findings.claim: Booking (April 2026) lowered FY2026 growth expectations but maintained core demand intact, framed as cyclical slowdown not structural decline; CEO cited rising global wealth and offline-to-online migration as structural tailwinds.
Phocuswright projects global travel gross bookings from ~$1.6T (2024) to >$1.8T by 2027, with about two-thirds booked online.
findings.source: Phocuswright: How global travel will grow, shift and digitize by 2027

findings.claim: STR/CoStar: US hotel room supply growth 0.4% in 2026 and 0.6% in 2027, rooms under construction at 12-year low; Europe supply +2.3% in 2027 with occupancy declining in 14 forecast markets; US RevPAR 2027 forecast +2.1% (Q3 2026 update).
findings.source: CoStar/STR Global Hotel Market Forecast Assumptions Q3 2026
